payload.content: The bug in `/workspace/search.py` was in the `while` loop condition (`lo < hi`), which caused the algorithm to miss the target if it was at the last index or if the search space reduced to a single element. I updated the condition to `lo <= hi` to correctly include the final element in the search. Verified with test cases.
